intro: Botswana is a parliamentary republic and one of Africa's most stable democracies.

chapters.title: How it works
text: Parliament elects the president, who leads the government. Duma Boko became president in 2024. The House of Chiefs advises on custom.

chapters.title: Clean government
text: Botswana is often ranked the least corrupt country in Africa.

keyTerms.meaning: An advisory body of traditional leaders.
